The Shared Circuit Understanding Document (SCUD) for the 'bms-monitor-module' has been generated and saved to `/tmp/vhl_e2e_workspace_y3jico4x/bms-project_190f619c/bms-monitor-module.scud`. 

The document synthesizes the BQ79616 reference design with the specific requirements of the module boundary, including:
- 16-cell monitoring and balancing interface with 100mA safety fuses.
- Capacitor-isolated differential daisy chain communication (22nF/2kV).
- 8-channel NTC temperature sensing biased by TSREF.
- Exported CVDD (5V) for the current-sensing module.
- Removal of all evaluation-only components (LEDs, test headers, jumpers).

The design satisfies the hierarchy of truth by prioritizing boundary safety requirements (fuses) and functional needs over the baseline evaluation schematic.
